description: Trigger precision eval for ue-level-analysis skill. Tests correct activation on World Partition level-content queries (OFPA scan, level actors/composition, spatial density, DataLayer audit) and correct rejection of project-level WP status, Blueprint flow, material, execution-trace, and other sibling-skill queries. Negative cases mirror routing.json negative_patterns (Issue #20028).

cases.query: 이 World Partition 프로젝트 레벨 분석해줘. OFPA 액터 몇 개고 어떤 레벨에 뭐가 배치돼있는지 구성 보고 싶어
cases.reason: Full level-content scan + composition on a WP project — core skill intent

cases.query: LV_Main 레벨에 어떤 액터들이 들어있는지 자세히 보여줘
cases.reason: Per-level actor breakdown — routes to level_get_summary
Blueprint placement lookup across levels — level_bp_usage

cases.query: 레벨 건강 상태 진단하고 스트리밍/DataLayer 문제 있는지 감사해줘
cases.reason: Level health diagnose + DataLayer audit — level_diagnose

cases.query: 액터 밀도가 높은 셀이 어디인지 spatial analysis 돌려줘
scan the OFPA actors in this level and show me the level composition graph
cases.reason: English OFPA scan + composition graph — level_get_graph

cases.query: what actors are placed in the streaming level and which blueprint classes do they use
cases.reason: English 'what actors' level content query — level_find_actors

cases.query: Gameplay.Objective 태그 붙은 액터들이 레벨 어디에 있는지 찾아줘
cases.reason: Find actors by GameplayTag within levels — level_find_by_tag
Project-level WP status — routing.json negative_pattern; belongs to ue-project-ops (wp_get_status), NOT level-content analysis

cases.query: check the WP status of this project
cases.reason: English WP status — routing.json negative_pattern; ue-project-ops, not level analysis
Blueprint execution trace — belongs to ue-execution-trace skill
Material parameter analysis — belongs to material-analysis skill
Class explanation — belongs to ue-explain skill
DDC cache health — belongs to ue-project-ops (ddc_*), not level analysis
GAS ability/tag analysis — belongs to gas-development skill
Sequencer cinematics editing — belongs to ue-sequencer-cinematics skill
